changes: MeaningLock protects abbreviated month dates, including Sept. and case variants.
DEV_ONLY grounded output rejects new abbreviated-month dates after normalization.
Ambiguous year-last numeric dates are compared as opaque source literals, without assuming locale.
Source date hints include both abbreviated months and year-last numeric literals.
limits: This guards explicit date drift only; it is not semantic verification, human review, model-quality certification or production model approval.
